T: I'm your huckleberry. Pass the beans.
D: Wyatt Earp and his brothers settle in Tombstone and clash with a gang of outlaws.
P: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday sits down at the faro table.
S: Hard boiled eggs pickled for 3 days in a beet and vinegar brine
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, peeled, packed into a jar with hot vinegar, beetroot juice, sugar, mustard seed and peppercorns, pickled 3 days until pink.
Smoky pepper beef jerky with cheddar
the long rides out of town

Thin-sliced topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, cracked pepper and smoked paprika, dried low and slow, with crackers, sharp cheddar and pickles. Freeze 800g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 80ml soy, 3 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Pat dry, lay on racks over trays and dry at 70C with the door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery. Serve with crackers, 200g sharp cheddar and pickles.
Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot cast iron pan
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot buttered cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes. Honey butter.
M: Saloon rump steak and molasses beans

Thick rump seared over hot coals and rested, with smoky beans simmered with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard, and crusty bread to mop up. Fry 150g diced bacon and a diced onion until golden. Add 2 drained tins cannellini beans, 400g crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 200ml water and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Season 1kg rump steak and cook over hot coals or a smoking pan 4 minutes a side, rest 8 minutes and slice. Serve with the beans and crusty bread.
Beef chuck slow braised with dried chiles, cumin and tomato
Beef chuck diced, browned, braised 3 hours with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato, no beans, Texas style. Cornbread alongside.
W: Lattice topped peach pie in a sweet shortcrust
Peaches sliced with sugar, lemon and cornflour, in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.
K: Rye whiskey stirred with demerara syrup and orange bitters, one big ice cube

Rye whiskey stirred down over ice with demerara syrup and orange bitters, poured over a big cube with a flamed orange twist. Dissolve 2 tbsp demerara sugar in 2 tbsp hot water and cool. For each drink, stir 60ml rye whiskey, 7ml demerara syrup and 2 dashes orange bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain over one large ice cube in a tumbler. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the glass near a lit match so the oil flares, then drop it in.

Pour into the hot pan and bake.

Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the chillies, cumin and tomatoes.
Braise covered until tender. Serve with the cornbread.
Slice the peaches and toss with the sugar, lemon juice and cornflour.
Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets, fill, and weave a lattice from the other two.
Bake at 190C.
Cool slightly and serve with cream.

s.note: Hard boiled eggs pickled for 3 days in a beet and vinegar brine
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Heat 250ml white vinegar, 125ml beetroot juice from a tin, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp mustard seeds and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over the eggs in a jar and refrigerate 3 days until pink.

s.note: Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot cast iron pan
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

m.note: Beef chuck slow braised with dried chiles, cumin and tomato
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves, add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin and 1 tin crushed tomatoes. Braise covered for 3 hours until tender. Serve with the cornbread.

w.note: Lattice topped peach pie in a sweet shortcrust
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 100g sugar, the juice of a lemon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more sheets. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: Rye whiskey stirred with demerara syrup and orange bitters, one big ice cube
d.how: Dissolve 2 tbsp demerara sugar in 2 tbsp hot water and cool. For each drink, stir 60ml rye whiskey, 7ml demerara syrup and 2 dashes orange bitters with ice for 30 seconds. Strain over one large ice cube in a tumbler. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the glass near a lit match so the oil flares, then drop it in.
